subject: OPERATOR/NANCY DECISION: error-reading labs (quota exhaustion, 'read the error') cannot be graded to the Lab 1 bar -- the cloud leaves NO trace when it refuses you, so evidence is student-captured and forgeable; end-state checks cannot close it (adversarial cheat scores full marks). Options: (1) ship ungraded+labelled, (2) fold error-reading into gradeable labs as natural steps [REC now], (3) build cloud seeded-failure plumbing so the check verifies a REPAIR -- real state, actually gradeable [REC as the real Stage 4 investment; needs a runSeed equivalent for the cloud path]. Checks 7-9 deployed on bc1 but inert (no page references them). Harnesses committed as the record. See scoping doc.
